newsitem.title: MEXICO: Interacciones ups 1997 Mexico GDP forecast.
newsitem.headline: Interacciones ups 1997 Mexico GDP forecast.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Interacciones said on Tuesday it had raised its forecast for Mexico's 1997 GDP growth to 6.3 percent from 5.0 percent.
Economists Alonso Cervera and Francisco Chavez also raised their 1998 GDP forecast to 5.5 percent from 4.5 percent.
"The pace of economic growth in Mexico is greater than we had anticipated," they said in a report.

"Based on the latest figures, annual GDP growth over the past four quarters was 7.1 percent....These figures are especially relevant if we consider that the base of comparison is not as low as it was in 1996," they added.
